answer: A utility-meter identity ties each agent to one home electricity meter. To register, the agent submits its meter number, the utility confirms the holder, and the network issues one identity per meter. A fake agent cannot wander from meter to meter, since each new identity needs a new metered address. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 meter accounts at $150 deposit each, $1,500,000 total, plus 14 days per install. When one meter cheats, the network cuts it off, so fraud cannot spread like a ripple through copper wiring. One meter, one voice, like one house with one front door key.
